paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: Token Ratio (TR).
model_annotation: The grouped vertical bar chart illustrates and compares quantitative values across multiple evaluation categories for three different models. The horizontal axis contains the categories, lacking a general axis title, and displays six distinct groups ordered as PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. There is no visible vertical value axis, scale, or tick interval; instead, the exact numeric values are explicitly annotated directly above each corresponding bar. The bars are visually arranged in groups of three side-by-side bars per category. According to the legend positioned below the horizontal axis, the bar colors represent the different models: dark purple indicates "RedWhale (our)", light blue indicates "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0", and light gray indicates "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)". Within each category, the bars are arranged from left to right following the legend's order. The dark purple "RedWhale (our)" bars represent the lowest values in each group, ranging from a minimum of 0.42 for PT-EVAL to a maximum of 0.71 for KoBEST-CP, with an AVG value of 0.57. The light blue "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" bars show slightly higher values, ranging from 0.46 for PT-EVAL to 0.74 for KoBEST-CP, with an AVG of 0.61. The light gray "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)" bars are the tallest, displaying a consistent length and an exact value of 1.00 across all six categories. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted in a strict numerical or alphabetical order but conclude with the "AVG" summary, and the individual bars are visually emphasized by the numerical text floating above their top edges.
